_why: Per-file count of c43 constants a z47 harness header declares by hand. These are frozen references one level below a frozen oracle: correct today, unable to move when c43 moves. The ratchet allows a count to FALL and never to rise; the fix is build/tests/c43_oracle.zig, which lets a lane compile against upstream's own c47.h and declare nothing.
_drifted: Copies whose value ALREADY disagrees with c43 and is not deliberate. Recorded rather than fixed, and reprinted on every run; a drifted name NOT on this list fails the gate. The usual cause is a mock header inventing its own compact numbering for a c43 enum, which converting the lane to compile against upstream's c47.h deletes outright.
_deliberate: Divergences from c43 that are DESIGN DECISIONS, not stale copies, each with the reason it is one. Hand-authored: --bump preserves this map and never adds to it. An entry with an empty reason FAILS the gate.

build/tests/memory/c47.h.RAM_SIZE_IN_BLOCKS: The memory lane models c43's block allocator over a DELIBERATELY tiny pool so a host test binary can exhaust it, walk it and diff it whole; c43's 65534 blocks would make every full-pool case unrunnable. Taking upstream's value would not be a fix, it would delete the lane's method. The allocator LOGIC is what is under test and it is size-independent.
